simple.meaning: בִּעוּתִים (biʻûwthîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “alarms.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בִּעוּתִים (H1161) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 6:4, with occurrences in Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בִּעוּתִים (H1161) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בִּעוּתִים (H1161) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בִּעוּתִים (biʻûwthîym) / H1161 is traced through Job 6:4, Psalms 88:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
